name: Hida Tobira
source:
A suspicious street vendor. A shady man who is involved in dangerous business. His real identity is unknown. In Memories Off ~Sorekara~ he intervenes between [url=/c11657]Isshu[/url] and [url=/c11649]Inori[/url], thus becomes an important key character in the story. [spoiler]Later it is revealed that he grew up in the same orphanage as Isshu. Furthermore, it has been assessed by Shin that Toby's nature is not as bad as they say it is.[/spoiler]
